FROM T_TRADE A LEFT JOIN SETTLE_TRANS_DATA STD ON A.BROKER_TRADE_ID = STD.CJBH AND A.SEC_ACCT_ID = STD.SEC_ACCT_ID AND A.Trading_Day = TO_CHAR(STD.TRADE_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AND STD.DELIVERY_RESULT IN ('01', '02', '03') AND ((STD.PS = 'T56' AND STD.TRADE_MARKET = '03' AND STD.BUSI_SCENE_CALSS NOT IN ('0902RB02', '0902RS03')) OR (STD.PS = 'T56' AND STD.TRADE_MARKET = '04') OR (STD.PS != 'T56')) LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO SCI ON A.FINANCE_ACCOUNT = SCI.ACCT_NO LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST_DETAIL EED ON A.INSTRUCTION_ID = EED.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PP ON EED.PORTFOLIO_ID = PP.PORTFOLIO_ID
ORDER BY A.CREATE_TIME DESC
